The adapter correctly inventories all DaemonSets/Deployments/StatefulSets/NodeSets and refuses any other spec referencing the selector, proving the target NodeSet selector. It re-runs the complete observation+native admission before each node CAS, checks live lease RV again, and records post conditions. Printed contract flags are asserted. The explicit verified predicate replaces the tautological True. Pair-wide atomicity is impossible across Kubernetes objects; PARTIAL_OR_UNVERIFIED is retained on any mid-pair failure, with no automatic rollback restoring workers or granting GPUs. The script stops and never automatically runs canonical recover. This is a safe stop-only action while both GPUs remain fenced, not an all-or-nothing grant. Slurm bit definitions match the frozen predecessor: requiring bits 1..4 is intentional (workers may be present or absent, no resume permitted, unrelated positive bits never mean an error). Unknown values above 511 are rejected. The lock file and test controls are consistent.
